Header: Date: 2026-03-20 10:00 PDT | Duration: 62 minutes | Attendees: Avery Patel, Morgan Liu, Samira Khan, Diego Fernandez, multiple employees

[00:00] Avery Patel: Hey everybody, welcome to the March all-hands, thanks for joining early. quick admin items, we have slides and recording as Morgan mentioned. um let's get started.
[00:15] Morgan Liu: Quick admin — slides are up in #all-hands, link in chat, and we'll record. also if you have Q's drop them in the Q&A or the slack thread.
[00:45] Samira Khan: Kicking off product updates, high level: Dedicated GA and Private pilot metrics, um, adoption is up 35% quarter over quarter, cost per token improved with quant profiles, some of you have seen the Optimize suggestions in beta.
[01:20] Diego Fernandez: On the infra side, we shipped the new continuous batching layer, it's reduced tail latency for short prompts by ~12%, although there was an edge case with KV cache warming during canary traffic, we fixed that last week.
[02:05] Employee 1: Can you say more about the outage on March fifth? there was a lot of customer noise.
[02:18] Morgan Liu: Yeah so quick recap — March 5th was a cascade after a kernel/regression on a specific GPU driver combo, it triggered heavier than expected memory fragmentation, fallback routing handled 90% of requests but we did hit latency SLOs for 24 minutes. Postmortem is underway.
[03:00] Avery Patel: Want to emphasize two things — first the incident response was solid, second we need better pre-release benchmarks across our supported driver matrix.
[03:40] Samira Khan: Product roadmap — prioritized items: 1) Dedicated autoscale policies (Q2), 2) Private VPC onboarding flow improvements (Q2), 3) Console trace integration for per-route latency (end of Q2), 4) Optimize GA with model recommendation engine (early Q3).
[04:25] Employee 2: Any notes on pricing for Dedicated? customers asking about minimums.
[04:35] Avery Patel: We're updating our Dedicated pricing page; expect clearer reserved capacity tiers and burst options. Finance intends to share a preview with Sales by 2026-03-24.
[05:05] Diego Fernandez: Tech deep-dive highlight — compiled kernels now choose execution path based on seq length histograms; we saw 20% CPU offload for long-context workloads on our test fleet.
[05:50] Employee 3: Question about Private on-prem packaging — is air-gapped supported yet?
[06:05] Morgan Liu: We have an air-gapped installer prototype; Security is finishing KMS/HSM docs. Not GA but a pilot customer has it running in a secluded cluster.

[06:50] Samira Khan: Hiring — we are opening roles in backend, reliability, and developer experience. People Ops will run a hiring open office hours next week.
[07:20] Avery Patel: Org changes — promoting Diego to VP of Engineering Operations, congrats, he'll focus on reliability, infra scalability and SRE tooling.
[07:50] (applause)  

[08:10] Q&A segment — we picked a few questions from Slack and live chat.
[08:25] Employee 4: Can sales share a playbook for Dedicated upsells? we need tactics.
[08:40] Samira Khan: Yes, Sales Enablement is building a playbook — will include benchmark examples and deployment templates.
[09:05] Employee 5: What's the plan for model catalog curation? customers want transparency.
[09:18] Morgan Liu: We'll publish a 'verified' model list with performance profiles, and a changelog for model variants and quantization profiles.

[55:00] Avery Patel: Closing remarks — Q1 was strong, focus for Q2: reliability, Dedicated scale, and shipping Optimize. Appreciate the grind. Let's keep customer empathy front and center.
[56:30] Action items recap: Samira to share roadmap, Diego to publish postmortem, People Ops to open hiring pipeline. Links: slides (https://drive.redwood/all-hands/mar-2026), roadmap draft (https://docs.redwood/product/roadmap-mar2026), incident doc (internal link), hiring tracker (sheet link).

Recording end.
